children: HCW Biologics entered into an Exclusive Distribution Agreement with Akron Biotech to commercialize HCW11-006 as a reagent for cell therapy manufacturing and other ex vivo uses worldwide, excluding China. Closing is subject to due diligence and testing under a Material Transfer Agreement and is expected no later than Nov 30, 2026; the term runs five years from closing, and HCW may terminate for convenience while continuing supply to support existing Akron customers. The parties will negotiate a Supply Agreement within 60 days after closing. HCW will receive $200,000 at closing, $100,000 within 30 days of the Supply Agreement, and $100,000 on each of the first and second anniversaries, plus quarterly payments for technical support as needed.
